blocks.text:
## What to expect on your trip

Peru brings together several historical periods and very different landscapes. Lima preserves a large colonial centre and one of the country's major museum collections. Cusco remains a city where Inca walls stand alongside Spanish architecture, while the Sacred Valley leads to the archaeological sites of Chinchero, Moray and Ollantaytambo.

The highlight of the route is Machu Picchu. From there, the journey continues across the Andean Altiplano to Puno and Lake Titicaca, where the programme includes the floating Uros Islands and Taquile Island.
